scenes.say: Here's the whole story in under a minute.
scenes.text: Persia to Iran | in a minute

scenes.say: It began as 240 kingdoms, bound by language and faith.
scenes.label: Kingdoms on the Iranian plateau
scenes.speak: It began as two hundred and forty kingdoms, bound by language and faith.

scenes.say: When one rose, it ruled the rest without erasing them: the King of Kings.
Alexander conquered it, and adopted its ways.
The Arab conquest brought two centuries of silence.
Turks and Mongols came, and became Persian kings.
Arabic has no P, so Pars became Fars.
scenes.title: A lost letter

scenes.say: But those who fled to India kept the old name: Parsi.
1935: Persia becomes Iran. 1953: a coup. 1979: revolution.
scenes.speak: Nineteen thirty-five: Persia becomes Iran. Nineteen fifty-three: a coup. Nineteen seventy-nine: revolution.

scenes.say: Now, under pressure again, Iran faces an old choice.
Silence, or renewal. It measures history in centuries.
